title: Feelings joined to images of the surround make a subject

statements.text: The continuous fabric of feeling lets organisms experience their own life process. Combined with images of the environment, it yields a perspective of the organism relative to its surround, a subjective perspective whose subject is the felt organism. This is likely the biological origin of the self.

sources.quote: This literally constitutes a subjective perspective, where the ‘subject’ is the felt/experienced organism.
In all likelihood, this is the biological origin of the self process.
